en: Shout for joy and sing your praises to the King
Lift your voice high, let your Hallelujahs ring
Come before His throne to worship and adore
Enter joyfully now the presence of the Lord
You're my Creator, You're my Deliverer You're my Redeemer You are Lord, and You're my Healer

ko: 나의 치료자 나의 선한 목자 되신 주
en: You're my Provider You're my Shepherd and my Guide
Jesus, Lord and King, I worship You
